sentences.text:
2. The petitioner is seeking regular bail Crime No.168/2023 of Chikkodi Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 34 of Indian Penal Code (for short "IPC") and Sections 9, 10, 11 of Child Marriage Act-2006 and Sections 4, 6, 17 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act-2012.
3. Brief facts of the case:-
The complainant has stated that, she was working as Supervisor for 12 years and now she is working in the office of Child Development Planning Officer, Nipani.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act-2012.
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: On 29.07.2023, she was informed by Chikkodi police that a minor girl aged about 17 years 10 months has given birth to a child in the hospital.
Immediately, she went to hospital and enquired the victim regarding the fact.
The NC: 2023:KHC-D:14655 victim has narrated the incident that she is the resident of Nagaral village, Chikkodi Taluk.
The parents of the victim have performed the marriage with the son of her maternal aunt who is aged about 26 years.
The victim has stated that, she is residing at her matrimonial house.
4. Based on the information, an investigation was carried out and the charge sheet came to be submitted by the jurisdictional police.
5. It is the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner that, the petitioner is the husband of the victim.
The marriage between petitioner and victim was performed as per the Hindu rights and customs.
The age of the victim was not aware as on the date of the marriage.
The parents of the victim have informed the petitioner that the victim has completed 18 years and marriage may be solemnized.

6. It is further submitted that, though the school certificate obtained by the investigating officer regarding NC: 2023:KHC-D:14655 the age of the victim, the certificate is not conclusion proof to Mr Maruti S/O Kallappa Heggannavar vs State Of Karnataka on 14 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2719489/
2 determine the age of the victim.

entities.text: Kallappa Heggannavar vs State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner is innocent of the alleged offence and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The petitioner is a resident of Nagaral village, and he is working as Agriculturist.
He will abide the conditions imposed by this Court in the event of his release on bail.
Making such submission, the learned counsel for the petitioner prays to allow the petition.

7. Per contra, Shri. Praveena Y. Devareddiyavara, learned High Court Government Pleader,
vehemently opposed the bail application and submitted that the petitioner has committed heinous offence.
He being a relative of the victim married her knowingly that she has not completed 18 years and committed sexual assault on several occasions.
Consequently, she became pregnant and gave birth to a child.
Therefore, the petitioner is not entitled for bail.

Making such submission, the learned HCGP prays to dismiss petition.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:14655 8.

Having heard the learned counsel for the respective parties, and perused the averments of the charge sheet and also complaint, it appears that the victim and the petitioner married as per the Hindu rights and customs.
Their marriage was performed by the parents of them.
As per the averments of the charge sheet and also submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner, the petitioner was not aware about the actual age of the victim and married her.
It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the victim has not stated anything about her age in the hospital.
The hospital authority has wrongly informed the police and the complainant has registered a case without clarified the age of the victim with the parents of the victim.
Therefore, taking into consideration the said submission and also facts and circumstances it is appropriate to grant bail by imposing suitable conditions.

9. Hence, I proceed to pass the following:-
NC: 2023:KHC-D:14655 ORDER
The petition is allowed.

The petitioner is ordered to be enlarged on bail in Crime No.168/2023 of Chikkodi Police Station on executing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One lakh only) with one surety for the likesum to the satisfaction of the Trial Court,
subject to the following conditions:
a) The petitioner shall not threaten or tamper the prosecution witnesses nor hamper the proceedings of the Court.
b) The petitioner shall appear before the Trial Court on all dates of hearing without fail.
In case, if the petitioner violates any of the bail conditions as stated above, the prosecution will be at liberty to seek for cancellation of bail.
